result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane residential roadway lacking marked crossings or traffic control devices. While sidewalks are present, the lack of protected crossing infrastructure and the wide street width create a high-exposure environment for residents of the adjacent apartment complexes.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of a designated crossing area forces pedestrians to judge gaps in traffic across a wide roadway without any priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the main roadway

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide road width increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic during a crossing maneuver.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the foreground and middle ground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner can obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the intersection corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to increase driver awareness and define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poor due to the complete absence of sidewalks on the residential side of the street, forcing pedestrians onto the grass or into the roadway. While a buffered bike lane is present, the lack of dedicated walking infrastructure and marked crossings creates a hostile environment for people on foot.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no dedicated paved space and must walk on uneven grass or in the bike lane/roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway adjacent to the houses.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks visible to provide a safe, designated path for pedestrians to cross the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalk on the residential side of the street to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental-style marked crosswalk to provide a designated crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add vertical delineators or a physical curb to the existing buffered bike lane to prevent vehicle encroachment and improve safety for all non-motorized users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poor, characterized by a complete lack of continuous sidewalks and marked crossings. Dense vegetation creates significant sightline obstructions at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to share space with vehicles or navigate unpaved surfaces.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways for pedestrians, forcing them to walk on the road shoulder or grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left side of the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Overgrown trees and bushes block the view of the intersection for both drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the corner

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk along the roadway to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove overgrown vegetation at the corner to restore clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a wide residential arterial road with sidewalks but no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas. The multi-lane design and lack of traffic calming measures create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes without traffic calming encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.
